task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log entry and extract the timestamp, log level, and message using a regular expression
solution_criteria: The regex should correctly capture timestamp in ISO 8601 format, log level (INFO, ERROR, WARNING, DEBUG), and the remaining message text from a CloudWatch log line

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and returns True if it follows AWS naming conventions (lowercase, 3-63 characters, no consecutive hyphens)
solution_criteria: Function should validate all S3 bucket naming rules and return a boolean. Should handle edge cases like buckets starting/ending with hyphens or numbers

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda environment that specifies runtime as Python 3.11, timeout of 60 seconds, memory of 512 MB, and includes environment variables for DATABASE_URL and API_KEY
solution_criteria: JSON should be valid AWS Lambda configuration format with correct key names, proper data types for numeric values, and all required fields properly structured
